pages.title: Perun's punishment
pages.text: When a wild Phoenix is slain you are told "Perun, God of the Sky, has noticed you", then "Run!", and you have 5 seconds. Then the Wrath lasts 5 minutes.$(br2)It deals one heart per second while you are in the Heatland, under the open sky, with a Phoenix feather in your inventory. It works through Spirit Form too.

pages.title: How to survive
pages.text: Take cover under a roof or in a cave, leave the Heatland, or get rid of the feather. Spirit Immunity, milk and a totem do not remove this wrath, and death cancels it.
